lines: tt-a1i/archify has 77,286 GitHub stars; turns code into interactive diagrams.
Developers struggle to understand complex systems because the connections between components remain hidden in raw code.
Archify is an agent skill that turns any codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram for developers.
The agent makes a JSON model, validates it, then delivers an HTML file only after passing checks.
Describe a web request flow, and Archify draws Browser to API, Redis cache miss, then PostgreSQL fallback.
The Proof Lab contains 11 checked-in scenarios with their validation receipts.
You can switch between dark and light themes in one click, then copy a PNG export straight to your clipboard.
Install with npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g, then use Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode.
Archify is MIT licensed, built on open-source code used in Proof Lab scenarios.
First, run npx skills add with the global flag to get Archify on your machine.
Save this for later so you can show anyone how complex systems really work.
Archify turns code into a visual story.
